newsitem.title: FRANCE: MOTOR RACING-PROST'S NEW TEAM STARTS IMPRESSIVELY.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-PROST'S NEW TEAM STARTS IMPRESSIVELY.

text.p: Four times world champion Alain Prost's takeover of the Ligier Formula One team started impressively in testing on Monday.
Frenchman Olivier Panis, who set the quickest time during testing at Barcelona, set a best lap of one minute 13.25 seconds.
It was quicker than the circuit record of 1:13.86 by Briton Nigel Mansell from pole position at the 1992 French Grand Prix.
"We've tried quite a number of things here since the end of last week and it's really beginning to take shape," said Panis.

"Despite the times we have recorded over the past few days, however, we must continue to put in the same effort and try to profit from the time we have before leaving for (the season-opening race in) Australia at the end of next week.
"Obviously I am extremely pleased with the progress we have made but we mustn't lose sight of the fact that the other teams who are currently down in Estoril are no doubt making progress as well."
